No new 5/5 — your top own-your-AI fits remain Wiki3 Own Your Own AI (TODAY Oct 28, 5/5), Own Your AI Model Factory (Nov 3, 5/5) and On-Device AI: Cleared for Takeoff (Nov 13, 5/5, now Luma-confirmed 5–9pm SF). Also resolved yesterday's gap: the Hacker Dojo iCal now confirms BOTH Nov 1 'Breaking Models' sessions (2:30pm reproduce-&-fix + 3pm Excessive Agency). The three highest-fit own-your-AI hackathons found this run — ExecuTorch (Meta×Qualcomm, on-device), Dell×NVIDIA GB10 'Local AI', and the NVIDIA Spark Hack Series — are all past or registration-closed/undated, so they're on watch rather than on the board. THIS WEEK (Oct 28–Nov 3): TODAY Oct 28 — Wiki3 Own Your Own AI (5/5, Hacker Dojo 6–7:30pm) + ComfyUI Dev Platform Build Night (4/5, Frontier Tower 3–10pm) + SF Physical AI (4/5, Antler 5:30pm) + ODSC×Nebius Hackathon (Burlingame) + Oakland Claude Code. Oct 29 — Collaborative Agent Hackathon @ Stanford + Robot Hackathon (29–30). Oct 30 — Post-Training & RL Buildathon / The Builder Base (4/5, 9:30am–7pm) + Night Hack IV @ Founders Inc (4/5, 4:15pm) + A Halloween Hackathon + Party (12pm). Oct 31 — STRANGER BUILDS Halloween hackathon. Nov 1 — Breaking Models ×2 @ Hacker Dojo (2:30pm + 3pm). Nov 2 — Fireworks: Deploy with Microsoft & NVIDIA (4/5, 9am) + OSA Con 2026. Nov 3 — Own Your AI Model Factory Hack Night (5/5, AWS Loft 5pm).
